description: The same records, but the sealer is one that only the removed root ever vouched for, and its grant and its seal are both dated before the change. Whoever holds a removed root can make exactly this: a sealer of their own and a history dated to suit. No root now in place vouches for that sealer, so its seal shows nothing, and the grant rests on the removed root's own word about when it signed.
name: roots-changed-and-the-old-roots-grant-was-sealed-by-a-sealer-only-the-old-root-vouched-for
